verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local LLM runtime and server, so memory management for the attention key/value cache is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack has no documentation of paged KV-cache management, fragmentation avoidance, or concurrent request capacity; the only load-time memory controls shown are GPU offload and context length, which are adjacent controls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
